title: A Six-Field Profile
label: ch:mr-a1-practical-form
canDo: I can independently choose and write six requested Marathi profile values without a model, then repeat the familiar task under a two-minute timer.

payoff.summary: After an untimed independent form and a partial timer, complete a six-field Marathi profile within two minutes from meanings alone.
payoff.note: This is timed practical-form task evidence only, not a 20-minute whole-paper mock or full A1 readiness.
